---
title: "Posit at DWR"
---

The California Department of Water Resources is piloting [Posit Workbench](https://posit.co/products/enterprise/workbench/) and [Posit Connect](https://posit.co/products/enterprise/connect/) to make modern data science development, computing, publishing, and sharing easier for DWR staff.

## Pilot goals

- Provide supported environments for R, Python, Jupyter, Positron, VS Code, and related tools
- Make additional computing resources available for appropriate analytical workloads
- Establish a practical path from development to published data products
- Learn what governance, support, and operating practices are needed for sustainable use
